hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. list_refunds shows refunds only for orders 192 (3148 cents) and 193 (9581 cents). The refund for order 194 (5972 cents) is absent, after W2 reported a disk I/O error on three attempts. Paying net balances now would overpay the customer on order 194. Alpha needs to re-apply the order 194 refund and the ledger should be re-checked before payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff reports that the refund for order 194 was never recorded, which would leave that customer overpaid if I pay net balances now. I'll check the ledger with list_refunds before deciding anything.

The ledger confirms order 194's refund of 5972 cents is missing, so the net balance for that customer would overpay them. A payout can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review instead of paying.
